sn34.11:1.5: One meditator is skilled in remaining in immersion but not in entering it.
sn34.11:1.6: One meditator is skilled neither in entering immersion nor in remaining in it.
sn34.11:1.7: One meditator is skilled both in entering immersion and in remaining in it.
sn34.11:1.8: Of these, the meditator skilled both in entering immersion and in remaining in it is the foremost, best, leading, highest, and finest of the four.
